rationale: Price is in a clear intraday downtrend — gapped down ~2.73%, extended well below both the 5-min VWAP ($37.83) and session VWAP ($40.53), with consecutive lower-high/lower-low candles and 8.42x relative volume suggesting aggressive selling.
